locations.post_fire: AUTAZES : AIRBORNE LIDAR : 2.5 YEARS AFTER FIRE

sentences.text: From the air the forest looks impenetrable and uniform.
LiDAR reveals the layers that can connect a surface fire.
Gaps expose the understory two and a half years after fire.
Sunlight and wind can dry the lower forest.
Non-native plants can occupy gaps and connect fuels.
Forest structure alone does not identify fuel.
